searchText: Any links where we can see live updates of the current testnet fork and progress? Are you planning sites for the next two testnets? Yes, the sites are already accesible at: sepolia.blobscan.com and holesky.blobscan.com. We will start indexing blob transactions once the upgrade is executed. `s/goerli/sepolia/g` : https://forkmon.sepolia.ethpandaops.io just a couple minutes now 2 slots! Same forkmon bug scared me again, but confirmed that our beacon roots match 🙂 And etherscan seems to have been updated ahead of time this time as well 🙂 🕰️ almost finalized
